audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty text was generic. Levels 1-2 are concretely yours on range: Command: Attack is 815 range, Chain Lash is 775, and both Kingslayer and Abscond are 400-range closers.
audit.why: Kit ranges from the brief give a hard reason for the early edge instead of 'auto-weave levels'.
audit.corrected: breakdown.early rewritten around the 815 vs 775 range gap and his 400-unit closers.
sources: brief enemyKit Q range 775, W/E range 400

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes claimed 'Luden's makes Q-W a third of a health bar' (magnitude with no source) and called level 6 a doubling of your presence, ignoring that Hijack copies Shockwave.
audit.why: Sylas R is 80/55/30s and steals the enemy ultimate; at 6 that is his spike, not a clean one for you.
audit.corrected: Spike line now: mana at Lost Chapter, level 6 belongs to Hijack, Luden's restores the poke edge.
sources: brief enemyKit R cd 80/55/30, text 'steals the enemy's ultimate ability'

audit.whatIsWrong: Two places asserted Kingslayer heals off minions ('W heals off your minions', 'Shove so his W has fewer minions to heal from'). Riot's own text says it heals 'against enemy champions'. Also 'Dash into chain-stun' was pasted under unrelated titles, and the E window was called 'fifteen-second' when Abscond / Abduct is 13/12/11/10/9.
audit.why: Per the kit-authority rule, Riot's description overrides. Shoving does not starve his heal — denying him a champion target does.
audit.corrected: Kingslayer restated as healing off you, not the wave; E window corrected to thirteen seconds at rank 1; Abduct restated as the 400-unit dash plus recast chain.
sources: brief enemyKit W text 'healing himself against enemy champions'

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it at all.
audit.why: It is the field that must hold real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Now names Abscond / Abduct 13s->9s, Kingslayer 12s early, Hijack 80s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization named Zed ('buy the stopwatch the moment Zed hits 6') in a Sylas matchup — template leak.
audit.why: Wrong champion shipped to a paying page.
audit.corrected: Zed -> Sylas; anti-heal clause now names Kingslayer, matching the flagged missing interaction.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[N].side disagreed with content win[N] on four of seven rows (0, 1, 4, 6).
audit.why: The page rendered two different answers for the same level row. phases[0/1/6].why already describe you winning, and content win[] matches the packet levelChart.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side, phases[1].side, phases[6].side -> Orianna; phases[4].side -> Skill with its why rewritten to the Hijack-copies-Shockwave verdict. Proposed as one atomic chart group.

edits.before: Shockwave online — your lane presence doubles without casting anything. Every wave he contests is a potential flip.
edits.after: Even at 6: Shockwave doubles your presence, but Hijack copies it on an 80s cooldown, so whoever ults second wins.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Command: Protect like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Abscond / Abduct is down 13s at rank 1, 9s at max — that window is your whole lane, so step up and Q-W the moment he dashes. - Kingslayer heals him every 12s early; shove so it feeds off nothing. - Hijack is 80s at rank 1: bait it, then Shockwave.

edits.before: Sylas wins by landing Abscond / Abduct, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Sylas wins by Abducting you off the ball, healing the trade back with Kingslayer, and Hijacking your Shockwave at 6.

edits.before: Win the auto-weave levels: passive stacks hurt, ball placement zones, and Q-W trades punish every wave contact. Mana is the only brake.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are yours: 815 Q range beats his 775 Chain Lash, and Kingslayer and Abscond both need 400 units. Chip him on every last-hit.

edits.before: Best wave: a Q-W slow push you crash on roam timers — your clear is instant from Luden's and the ball travels with the shove. Worst wave: a frozen wave at his tower with the ball behind you — walking up ball-less into gank season is how Ori lanes end. Crash timing: shove with a destination in mind; mid waves are bus tickets, not chores.
edits.after: Best wave: a Q-W slow push crashed on his Hijack timer — shoving also starves Kingslayer, which only heals off what it hits. Worst wave: a frozen wave at his tower with the ball behind you — Abscond covers 400 units and you have nothing to shield with. Crash timing: shove with a destination in mind; mid waves are bus tickets, not chores.

edits.before: Lost Chapter steadies the trade game; level 6 doubles your lane presence; Luden's makes Q-W a third of a health bar.
edits.after: Lost Chapter steadies your mana; level 6 is his, not yours, because Hijack copies Shockwave; Luden's restores the poke edge.

edits.before: If Sylas gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Abscond / Abduct extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with Q-W clears and stay relevant through Shockwave threat.
edits.after: A fed Sylas Abducts through your minions and Kingslayer heals most of it back — stand behind the wave and only step to Q-W when his E is on its 13s. Buy anti-heal before you contest again.

edits.before: Carry through the ball — no champion controls teamfight space like Orianna; one Shockwave on three is a won game, and you decide when it happens.
edits.after: Carry by holding Shockwave past his Hijack: once he has spent a stolen ult or it is on its 80s, your R on three is unanswered and the fight is yours.

edits.before: You are the fight: ball on the diver, Shockwave the clump, Dissonance the retreat. Position behind your front line and let the sphere do the dying.
edits.after: Sylas hunts you first, so ball on yourself and let Abduct land him inside your Shockwave. Once his Hijack is spent, your R decides the fight.

edits.before: Ahead, run the clock: shove with Q-W, zone Sylas off every contact with ball threat, and rotate first to rivers — your Shockwave makes every skirmish a 5v4 audition.
edits.after: Ahead, deny the ult trade: hold Shockwave until Hijack is spent, keep the ball on yourself so Abduct pulls him onto a Dissonance field, and take every river fight.

edits.before: Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Command: Protect is 9s and 1095 range — ball on yourself blunts his Abduct burst.

edits.before: Ball on his farm path, Q-W the last-hit contact, auto-weave once, and recall the ball — three-second trades his combo math can't answer.
edits.after: Drop Dissonance on the ground he must cross after Abscond — the 7s W field slows his escape and speeds you out of Chain Lash range.

edits.before: Sylas burns Abscond / Abduct on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Sylas burns Abscond / Abduct on nothing — take the thirteen-second invitation.

edits.before: That is Sylas’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: At 6 a stranded ball is a free Hijack window — hold R and keep the sphere near you.

edits.before: Ball-on-self is your Flash — stranding the sphere at poke range with his engage loaded is the only way this lane kills you.
edits.after: Abscond plus Abduct covers ground fast from fog — ward both river entrances before you crash, or the shove becomes his gank.

edits.before: Track Sylas’s Abscond / Abduct: Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Abscond / Abduct: he dashes 400 units, then recasts to chain you in. It is on 13s at rank 1 — step up then, not before.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Luden's Companion into Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's. Zhonya's vs dive — buy the stopwatch the moment Zed hits 6. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Luden's Companion into Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's. Zhonya's vs dive — buy the stopwatch the moment Sylas hits 6. Add anti-heal early into Kingslayer.

edits.before: Sylas comes online with his full Q-W-E kit: he E-dashes in, Q double-hits, and W heals off your minions, so his all-in is live once he hits 3.
edits.after: Sylas comes online at 3: Abscond in, recast Abduct to chain you, Chain Lash for the double hit, and Kingslayer heals off you, not the wave.

edits.before: Shove so his W has fewer minions to heal from
edits.after: Kingslayer heals off you, not off the minions

edits.before: Sustain through poke with W off the wave
edits.after: Heal the trade back with Kingslayer on you

notes: Chart: phases[N].side disagreed with content win[N] on rows 0, 1, 4 and 6; win[] matched the packet levelChart and the whys, so the four sides were moved to match and phases[4].why was rewritten in the same group. phases[N].rating left untouched — the rating scale's polarity is not documented in the brief and I would be guessing.
